answer: Each agent registers a TPM endorsement key; a verifier checks the trusted manufacturer certificate chain and hashes the key into a registry that rejects duplicate hashes. A new key starts in the trellis state, a failed attestation moves it to marble, and a revoked or cloned key moves to onyx; only trellis keys may submit. Extra identities require separate physical TPMs, each costing an amortized per-epoch C, so total gain is n(R-C) and deters only while R<C. Stolen devices and compromised firmware remain.
